Subject: June marketplace invoice shows withheld payout — need help

Marcus —

We just pulled the June invoice from Cloud Marketplace and noticed a withheld payout line of $48,640 that wasn't in the June monthly remittance we typically receive. Attached is our export (June_ACME_usage_export.csv). The seller id on the invoice (seller-8793) doesn't match the seller id we have on file for our EU entity; it also looks like a regional allocation flagged the traffic as APAC which triggered a VAT withholding hold.

Can you help confirm whether Redwood's metering attribution sent a different seller mapping for June? We need the evidence to escalate to Marketplace payments — the funds are part of our customer refunds pipeline.

Attachments: June_ACME_usage_export.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Priya Shah

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the heads up and for including the export. I'm looking into the June batch now. A few quick clarifying questions so we can route efficiently to Marketplace payments:

- Is the seller id on the marketplace invoice exactly "seller-8793" (any trailing zeros or entity suffixes)?
- Can you confirm whether the withheld amount is already showing as a deduction on your June ledger or as a separate hold pending settlement?
- Do you have a VAT certificate for the seller entity you expect to receive the funds (this sometimes blocks automatic release)?

I've attached our internal June usage summary for the ACME account so you can see how we attributed usage across projects and regions (redwood_usage_summary_June.csv). I'll pull the low-level metering logs and a ledger snapshot and loop in Marissa for payout reconciliation.

Next step: I'll aim to escalate to Marketplace payments with the evidence bundle by tomorrow EOD (Tue).

Subject: Re: June marketplace invoice shows withheld payout — need help

Priya / Marcus —

I attached the ledger snapshot for Redwood's marketplace payouts on 2027-06-30 which shows the clearing buckets and the entity mapping used in June (ledger_snapshot_2027-06-30.pdf). From a quick scan I see that one of the usage blocks for ACME had a region tag of "APAC" applied by our ingestion pipeline for a subset of calls coming from an IP range that overlaps the customer's EU and APAC CIDRs. That mis-tagging can cause the Marketplace to route the payout to a seller id that doesn't have the VAT certificate on file, leading to withholding.

Action items I suggest:
- Marcus: escalate to Cloud Marketplace payments with both the ACME export and our ledger snapshot (attached).
- Priya / ACME: please confirm which seller id you want the funds routed to and share the VAT cert for that legal entity (we can redact the VAT number if needed for privacy).
- Jonas: can you pull the ingestion IP mapping for the affected projects (I'll reference the usage ids in my notes).

Attachments: ledger_snapshot_2027-06-30.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Cloud Marketplace Billing <payments@cloudmarketplace.example.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmestorage.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in June marketplace invoice / withheld payout for ACME

Marcus / Priya —

Thanks for the ticket and the attachments. We investigated the referenced invoice and confirmed that the payout was flagged for withholding because the payout was originally routed to seller-8793 which does not have a VAT certificate on file for the EU region. The underlying cause is a seller-entity remapping event on our side that ran during the 2027-06-29 reconciliation window and matched a subset of ACME usage to seller-8793 (APAC mapping).

To release the withholding we require:
1) Confirmation of the intended receiving seller id for ACME and the legal entity name.
2) A VAT certificate (PDF) for that receiving entity.
3) A short PO/authorization reference that ties the June invoice to the receiving entity (DocuSign or signed PO).

We can expedite once the above items are received — expected release timeline is 7–10 business days after confirmation and docs. I have attached the withholding notice we generated to ACME.

Attachments: withholding_notice.pdf

Regards,
Marketplace Payments Operations
Cloud Marketplace Billing
payments@cloudmarketplace.example.com
